about: The ONE list of study slots. The runner edits only a slot's status and, when a job ends, its receipt pins (paths, sha256, identity). study_spend.py reads this file fresh on every run and never writes it. Money strings are exact US dollars.

owner_stop.rule: if the spend upper bound passes (is strictly greater than) $30.00 while fewer than 3 slots marked counts_toward_training_stop are RUNNING or DONE, stop: every admission is refused and the runner reports to the owner
owner_stop.counting: only the main-comparison training jobs M1-M6 count (the owner's words were 'before the third seed'); the smoke runs S1 and S2 do not, and an INVALID slot does not, so the stop stays active as long as possible

allowances.basis: coordinator decision: a stated S3/transfer/retention allowance of $0.10 per job, added on top of the machine+address+disk bound (watched jobs) or on top of the training launcher's own $1.48 ancillary allowance (training jobs). It covers S3 requests, transfer out of AWS and 12 months of storage of up to about 0.36 GB of retained objects at $0.023 per GB-month. Measured sizes today: S2 retains 49,097,828 bytes of artifacts; P1a stored a 10,230,760-byte bundle plus about 1 MB of uploads. No better measured figure exists; no provider invoice is read.

slots.what: evidence collection + TEST readout + 18 checkpoint probe reads + gates, with a partial-study readout path (T4)
slots.scope: E1 runs in every branch of the plan, so it is always reserved. It INCLUDES: (1) collecting the retained evidence of every training slot that ran (the checkpoint and measurement objects each training receipt lists, from the retained buckets or the local receipts, into E1's bundle); (2) the TEST readout, the 18 checkpoint probe reads and the gates; (3) a partial-study readout path: if the study stops early (the $30 stop, a failed seed, or fallback B unfundable) E1 reads whatever checkpoints exist and reports COMPARISON_INCOMPLETE, on the same machine and deadline, so under the same cap
slots.runtime_bound: same limits as P1a: ONE machine at most g4dn.2xlarge, at most 100 GB disk, in-machine timer 120 min, power-off 123 min, client deadline at most 130 min, destroyed on shutdown
slots.cleanup_bound: the watcher confirms 'terminated' and lists no volume left, bound to the same instance id as the launch record
slots.timing_feasibility: NOT ESTABLISHED: E1 is not built. The per-checkpoint probe-read time on T4 is to be measured by P1b's corrected-probe validation; E1's admission needs 18 x that time + readout + gates within its own wall limit of at most 3,600 s, projected by its own timing preflight before any read
preconditions_outside_money_gate: P1b measured the per-checkpoint probe-read time on T4
